audit_items.proof_trace: Concurrent calls to MaxBlobsPerBlock perform in-place sorting of the shared BlobSchedule slice (L707-709) without locking. Production builds have no mutex; development RWMutex only protects getActive() but releases before field access. Mid-sort reads violate epoch-to-blob-count determinism.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends concurrent P2P blob requests at epoch boundaries (e.g., epoch 150 when schedule has entries at 100,200). Goroutines race in sorting; some observe partially-sorted state, compute wrong MaxBlobsPerBlock, causing consensus divergence or blob validation failures across nodes.
